title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
description: Togo Asagaki was the Red Ranger in a heroic Ranger squad. During their final battle against an evil organization, he gave his life to guarantee their triumph. But fate had other plans, and he found himself reborn in an entirely different world. Embracing his new role as an adventurer, he transforms into Kizuna Red and continues his pursuit of justice, helping those in need.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Yihdra is the brilliant child of a disgraced court mage, who seeks to redeem her family's reputation and use sorcery for good. But when she meets an adventurer who transforms into an all-red suit wielding otherworldly weapons, it could be the first step in achieving her dream... or it could drive her crazy!

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yihdra has become an adventurer to learn more about Togo and his powers, but after an adventuring duo earns her hatred with some rude remarks about her father, it escalates into a race to see who can clear a dungeon first.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Teltina, is the third princess of the kingdom of Avallost, joined by her Hero, Lowji. She is on a crusade to combat a threat to the people, and eager to recruit Yihdra and Togo, but her knight in shining armor isn't quite as enthusiastic...

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A Mana Seed-empowered lord is oppressing his citizens, so it's up to Togo and his friends to stop him.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Togo and his friends are brought to the Sorcery Tower, headquarters of Yihdra's rival.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: While Princess Teltina recovers, Red and Yihdra focus their efforts on investigating mana seeds and mana metal.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Red and the group set off on a mission to investigate the elves who live in a forest in the middle of a desert.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Raniya frets about confronting Azir, so Red shares a story about when he had to battle a friend of his own.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Red and his friends confront Azir, whose despotic conquest threatens the Sun Forest.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A newly empowered Azir faces off against Red and his friends, and the odds don't look good.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Azir becomes a rampaging sandstorm, forcing Red and the others to fight a literal force of nature.

episodes_data.title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Togo unleashes a forbidden power to save his friends, but it may end up costing him everything in exchange.
